description: Runs whose CFD labels carry a known numerical-setting uncertainty larger than the verification limits. Kept in the dataset (option A of the pre-registered regime test, verification_criteria_2026-11-06.md, result 2026-11-07); listed here so users can exclude or down-weight them. Kept separate from manifest_full_h5mm.json so the frozen manifest and its md5 do not change. Field differences are RMSE in % of the run's delta T against the dataset run.

regime_test.sample: 10 wide SST designs (W >= 0.6 m, Ri < 10), 5 per mode, chosen by md5 of run_id within Ri bins

flags.cause: phase error in the tilting and sloshing of the thermocline interface after the jet reaches it; nOuterCorrectors 4 and maxCo 0.25 agree with each other but not with production (2, 0.5)
flags.note: the main ML model's error on this run is of the same size as the label's own numerical uncertainty

flags.classification_note: not affected under the rule written before its test (rep >= 1.5 %); affected under the later ratio rule (n4 >= 2 x rep), which was added after this result (post hoc)
flags.note: the main ML model's error on this run is of the same size as the label's own numerical uncertainty

sensitive_not_flagged.note: flow sensitivity: a 0.01 % inlet change moves the field more than the numerical settings
field borderline, same size as flow sensitivity
